image_description: A close-up, warm-toned photograph of a ceramic cup with a decorative geometric pattern sitting on a matching saucer. The cup has a dark handle and a textured body with gold/brown lattice designs. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field in an indoor setting.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the object belongs to the 'cup' class and distinguishes it from bowls or mugs based on handle and proportion features.
Critical check for AI artifacts where handles often fuse into the body or float; ensures topological connectivity between handle and cup body.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or warping in the geometric lattice pattern which is a common failure mode in AI generation.
To verify correct spatial grounding and contact shadows between the cup and the saucer, ensuring no floating or bleeding artifacts.

focus_areas: Continuity and perspective correctness of the geometric pattern
Contact shadow between cup base and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the geometric pattern on the cup. In AI images, these patterns often warp unnaturally near the handle or fail to follow the cylindrical perspective correctly. Also, verify that the handle does not have any 'ghosting' or semi-transparent edges where it meets the background.
